# Tabler core

`tabler.min.css` is the unmodified core stylesheet from `@tabler/core` 1.6.1,
downloaded from https://registry.npmjs.org/@tabler/core/-/core-1.6.1.tgz.
Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler. MIT license included in LICENSE.
No chart plugins, external fonts, or JavaScript bundles are loaded.
MIGA-specific layout overrides are in `static/archive-dashboard.css`.
